parsed.rationale: All five members — AppleMusicService, BandcampService, SoundCloudService, SpotifyService, and YouTubeMusicService — are classified as `type-alias-object` at the same structural shape (shared_field_count: 1, no differing_slots) within the same package `MusicShareKit`, all at line 13 (except SpotifyService at line 21). This strongly suggests each is a thin type alias or trivially-shaped wrapper over a common underlying service shape. Rather than maintaining five parallel files in `Shared/MusicShareKit/Sources/MusicShareKit/Services/`, a `MusicService` protocol (potentially with an associated `Configuration` type for per-service parameterization) would unify the shared structure, allow generic consumers to depend on the protocol, and let each concrete type conform with only its distinguishing configuration. None of the records carry test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flags, so this is live production code where the duplication carries real maintenance cost.
